_note: Honest, approximate freight estimates for hauling produce to a mandi. NOT a quote — real cost depends on the day's diesel, the route, and what the transporter charges. Tuned so per-quintal cost is in a believable range for Indian mandi logistics (~₹0.4–1.5 per quintal per km once the vehicle is loaded). Edit these freely; the calculator reads this file live (cached by mtime). `rental_slug` names the /rental machine this tier IS, so the same page that costs the trip can show who near the farmer hires that vehicle out — an unknown or blank slug simply shows no owners.
